data.description: Mobile billboard truck with 'Paxton Protects Pedos' messaging deployed outside the W Hotel in Dallas Wednesday morning and driven around the RNC convention as counter-programming.
data.name: Texas Democratic Party mobile billboard targeting Ken Paxton (Dallas GOP convention counter-programming)
data.outcome: Attracted national and local news coverage; TDP publicly claimed credit on X.

summary: Mobile billboard truck deployed by the Texas Democratic Party outside the W Hotel in Dallas on the morning of Sept 9, 2026, with 'Paxton Protects Pedos' messaging.
title: TDP mobile billboard targeting Ken Paxton (Dallas GOP convention counter-programming)
